metadata_rules.ccts_methodology_statement: CCTS here = emissions × % cut × price, with no abatement and no growth to 2040, as a placeholder pending plant baselines.
metadata_rules.one_calculation_path_rule: All summary portfolio figures are derived strictly as the exact sum of the plant rows. Exposure is split into three separate components: heat (API-based), water+coastal (judgement), and CCTS (assumption). It must not be aggregated into an unlabelled single headline.
metadata_rules.flow_vs_stock_label_rule: All annual financial figures represent annual flows and are strictly labelled as 'per year' (INR Crores / year). They must not be compared to the balance sheet asset base without this explicit rate distinction.
metadata_rules.clinker_toggle_rule: The Clinker toggle changes only the Scope 1 and intensity columns. Fleet Scope 1 (10,932.0 kt) is the same in both views. CCTS is NOT invariant at notified rates (direct vs adjusted differ because integrated and grinding rates differ), so every INR value, including CCTS, is computed on direct emissions in both views.
metadata_rules.flood_data_role: Open-Meteo Flood API river discharge (m3/s) provides contextual hydrological background only and does NOT feed into the financial loss calculation. Lost operating days are derived strictly from the stated heat formula and the labelled judgement-based water and coastal assumptions.
metadata_rules.heat_bias_correction_method: Bias-aware delta method applied: Historical baseline (2015-2024) is sourced from ERA5-based reanalysis, not station data. 2040 projection is computed as historical baseline plus the CMIP6 multi-model ensemble change between 2015-2024 and 2036-2045 (delta method), per plant.

nominal_operating_days_per_year.justification: Standard Indian cement manufacturing operating window allowing 35 days for planned kiln relining, overhaul, and statutory inspections.

industry_ebitda_margin_per_tonne.justification: Industry benchmark EBITDA margin (~18-20% margin on average revenue realization of INR 5,263/t).

baseline_data.provider: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) via Open-Meteo Historical Archive API

climate_models_used_for_delta.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the two high-resolution CMIP6 models

factor_moderate_heat.unit: lost operating days per day in [40C, 43C)

acute_heat_flag_status.result: Dropped. Under the bias-aware ERA5 reanalysis baseline and delta method, no plant exceeds 25 days/year with Tmax >= 43C. Peak extreme heat occurs at P03 Chandrapur (13.8 d/yr baseline, 19.3 d/yr in 2040).
